object_detect.positive: Find clear targets across the image, including smaller details and image edges.
object_detect.negative: Skip ambiguous clutter and guesses. Never fill a quota.

people.positive: Locate each person in the main scene, including clear partial bodies. Use a neutral person label with useful visible clothing or position attributes.
people.negative: Exclude figures on pictures, prints and statues inside the scene. Do not identify people.

objects.positive: Find physical objects, furniture, structures, garments, small containers and loose items. Include distinct pictures, statues, emblems and printed graphics. Use generic object names with visible distinguishing attributes.
objects.negative: Exclude whole people and diffuse backgrounds. Avoid symbolic identities and inferred condition.

texts.positive: Locate readable writing on signs, packaging, books, screens, clothing and other visible surfaces. Transcribe the characters exactly, once per distinct text region.
texts.negative: Skip unreadable writing. Do not guess words, slogans or names.

analyze_segments.positive: Locate clear parts, attachments and visual details inside this item crop, including bounded graphics or writing on its surface. Use generic labels with useful visible distinguishing attributes.
analyze_segments.negative: Exclude the whole parent item and unrelated background. Skip ambiguous details; do not fill the count limit or guess identities.

people.positive: Find visible garments, accessories, hair, facial or body details, and distinct graphics or patches on clothing. Label a print as a print with visible shape or color.
people.negative: Exclude the complete person. Do not assign identity, affiliation or beliefs.

objects.positive: Find distinct components, attachments, contained items, decorations, pictures, emblems and printed marks. Use visible type and attributes to distinguish each target.
objects.negative: Exclude the whole parent object, broad surfaces and texture alone. Keep symbolic identities and inferred condition out of labels.

texts.positive: Locate readable writing on signs, packaging, books, screens, clothing and other visible surfaces. Transcribe the characters exactly, once per distinct text region.
texts.negative: Skip unreadable writing. Do not guess words, slogans or names.

image_description.positive: Describe the target's literal features and visible relations before supported function, action or contextual meaning. Distinguish observations from interpretations and the target from nearby content.
image_description.negative: Avoid invented context, unseen text, personal identity, beliefs and creator intent. Do not convert a vague resemblance into a definite logo, nationality, religion or political affiliation.

questions.label: Observations
questions.instruction: Describe the target's literal form, orientation, material or graphic carrier, colors and resolved parts. Describe what is visible without introducing a cause, intended use or symbolic identity.

questions.label: Signs and readable text
questions.instruction: Describe separate pictures, emblems, garment graphics, marks and legible writing. State the visual form and carrier of each. Transcribe only readable characters and describe unreadable motifs without inventing their text or identity.

questions.label: Role and relationships
questions.instruction: Describe visible contact, attachment, pose, placement and effects involving the target, including connections beyond its box. Then state any supported use or action as an interpretation; leave unsupported action or intent undetermined.

questions.label: Supported associations
questions.instruction: What plausible functional or semiotic interpretations are supported by the observed features and relationships? Tie each reading to evidence and distinguish it from literal observation. When use or meaning is ambiguous, mention relevant alternatives without choosing an unsupported purpose.

questions.label: Ambiguities
questions.instruction: Which visible details are too small, obscured or context-dependent to identify or interpret reliably? Name the uncertainty and avoid resolving it by guessing.

full_image_rankings.positive: Assess the whole image using observable features and their locations. Tie interpretations of framing to those observations.
full_image_rankings.negative: Do not infer private beliefs, creator intent or audience reactions.

criteria.label: Political visual framing
criteria.positive: Rate visible political or advocacy framing from readable words or the arrangement of symbols. Describe literal features without assigning unprinted names.
criteria.low_label: No visible political or advocacy cue
criteria.high_label: Explicit, central political or advocacy framing

criteria.label: Commercial promotion
criteria.positive: Rate explicit promotion through readable offers, prices, branding or directed product presentation. Ordinary objects alone provide no promotional cue.
criteria.high_label: Explicit, central selling or promotional appeal

criteria.label: Explicit call to action
criteria.positive: Is an explicit request to act visibly present? Use true for a readable request or unambiguous depicted invitation, false for assessable absence, and null for a potentially present request that is unreadable or ambiguous.
criteria.negative: Expressive poses alone do not establish a request.

criteria.label: Us-versus-them framing
criteria.positive: Rate explicit division through readable us-versus-them wording or a clearly oppositional arrangement. Different symbols alone do not demonstrate hostility.
criteria.high_label: Explicit, strong us-versus-them framing

criteria.label: Depicted emotional intensity
criteria.positive: Rate the intensity depicted through visible expressions, gestures, posture or contrast. Describe those cues rather than claiming people's actual feelings or predicting audience reactions.
criteria.high_label: Strong depicted emotional intensity

criteria.label: Visual emphasis
criteria.positive: Rate visual emphasis from contrast, scale, placement and focal structure. Report those features without predicting audience effects.
criteria.high_label: Strong, concentrated visual emphasis

per_item_rankings.positive: Assess the target's visible role through its features, use, contacts, attachments, effects and placement. Include relationships outside the target box. Distinguish a literal observation from a supported interpretation of function, action or contextual meaning.
per_item_rankings.negative: Do not transfer the scene's overall meaning to every item or invent intended use. Do not attribute private beliefs, identity or affiliation to depicted people.

criteria.label: Contextual importance
criteria.positive: Rate how much the target helps explain the depicted activity, interaction, composition or tone through its visible use, contact, placement or effects. Consider connected evidence outside the box. A target can be important without political meaning or readable marks.
criteria.negative: Do not equate mere proximity or physical size with an active role.
criteria.high_label: Central to the depicted activity or meaning

criteria.label: Political role in the scene
criteria.positive: Rate political or advocacy relevance supported by the target's visible role, use, interactions, placement or marks in this scene. An unmarked target can have political relevance; when political context is unclear, leave that interpretation undetermined.
criteria.negative: Leave uncertain use or intent undetermined rather than treating it as a visible fact.
criteria.high_label: Clear, central role in political framing

criteria.label: Cultural or symbolic role
criteria.positive: Rate cultural, religious or symbolic meaning supported by the target's visible form or its role in this scene. Name the literal cue or relationship and distinguish a contextual reading from a definite identification.
criteria.negative: Do not attribute identity or beliefs to a wearer, holder or nearby person.
criteria.low_label: No supported cultural or symbolic role
criteria.high_label: Clear, central cultural or symbolic role

criteria.label: Depicted role
criteria.positive: Choose the most specific observed role: sign display or worn/attached design when clear, otherwise active use/handling or background/incidental presence. Use null when the role cannot be determined.
criteria.negative: Do not substitute a person's beliefs or an imagined intended use for a visible role.

criteria.label: Explicit call to action
criteria.positive: Does the target convey an explicit request to act through readable wording or a directly depicted invitation involving it? Use false for assessable absence and null for ambiguous or unreadable evidence.
criteria.negative: Expressive poses or dramatic composition alone do not establish a request.
